correctness.rationale: The unit ball of N_w is the octagon with vertices (±1,±w),(±w,±1), 0<w<1. At exterior differentiability points associated with active supporting facet f and normalized z, DR(x)=(I−z⊗f)/N_w(x). The norm z↦||I−z⊗f|| is convex along an edge, so the operator supremum lies at a vertex; signed-coordinate symmetries reduce to z=(1,w) and vertical/diagonal facets. Their exact images are Q_V(u,v)=(0,v−wu) and Q_D(u,v)=((wu−v)/(1+w))(1,−1). Complete evaluation of |v−wu| over the eight vertices gives 1+w²; hence ||Q_V||=1+w², ||Q_D||=2(1+w²)/(1+w)². Piecewise differentiability along generic segments and continuity prove the global upper bound; exterior derivatives approaching the same endpoints prove the matching lower bound. The branch crossover w=√2−1 uniquely minimizes at 4−2sqrt2. Independently enumerated vertex dual norms in rational arithmetic and differentiated both expressions; no grid is used for the infinite proof.
